facts.fact: 逃亡：Rian 连环 lightspeed（半英里+半英里绕路）甩五追兵；「he missed the Sunbringer Spear」——一瞬想念矛（T1 曾核）。
facts.anchor: Rian stretched time and space to his liking

facts.fact: 街口汇合：撞上 Fin；枪手向逃难人群开火（如 machete cut a weed）——「This realm is on its way to ruin...You will find ours more suitable」；Fin 拉他南向（Nik went this way）。
facts.anchor: “This realm is on its way to ruin,”

facts.fact: 空中协作：Rian 展翼带 Fin 飞（Fin 尖叫受够飞行）；Fin 土魔法拆砖掷战士（如弹弓打鸟）——「I’m helping destroy my own fucking city!」；Rian 闪过一念：他告诉过他?还是告诉过 Phos?（泄密焦虑）。
塔崩：从 Gravespire 顶望见 crater 边两影（Dante）+天空大战——火风漩涡撞塔、ballistic explosion 灼热过日——海螺形塔碎裂倾倒。
facts.anchor: that maelstrom smashed into the side of the Gravespire.

facts.fact: Camilla 生还：Azideh「There's nothing you can do」——塔中亡魂尽碎；Dante 于悔恨/解脱间尝到烟味——废墟里一闪红光：她越狱了——「You did unbind her chains」。
开门工序：Dante 缺配料（amber/saffron/citrus/myrrh）——Julian 不需要：magic was stitched into his very being——两人空中画 quintessence 符悬于血 glyph 之上。
facts.anchor: All he had to do was become a well

facts.fact: 恶魔的评估：Julian 瞳孔缩长、绿眼近似 Azideh（Dante 喉头一响）；黑筋爬上颚；「It’s not opening...It's like he's…」——门不开。
facts.anchor: He feels familiar. And yet, dissimilar.

facts.fact: 章末开门：Rian/Fin 坠落坑边压住血符——Dante 问伤、Rian 道谢——Dante 拽近他一刀深割前臂内侧——血溅符与坑——白光爆裂全场。
facts.anchor: A blinding ray of white exploded through the square.
